title: How do workout templates work?
seoTitle: Workout Templates in augo | augo support
description: Build a library of reusable workouts, search it by discipline, RPE, duration or purpose, and assign them to athletes.
summary: Workout templates are your reusable library. Save a session once, then find it again by discipline, RPE, duration or purpose — the search is typo-tolerant — and assign it to any athlete. augo tracks how many times each athlete has completed a session built from it.
questionForms: reuse the same workout every week
can i save a session and use it again
how do i assign a workout to an athlete
how do i find a session i built before
can i search my saved workouts
how do i see how often an athlete did a session

body.html: A workout template is a session you save once and reuse. If you coach more than a handful of athletes, this is where most of the repetitive work goes away.

Finding one again

The library is searchable, and the filters combine:

  • Discipline — run, bike, swim or other
  • RPE — matches any template with a step whose RPE range overlaps yours
  • Estimated duration
  • Purpose — what the session is for
  • Free text — typo-tolerant search across title and purpose

You can also filter by when a template was last assigned, which is a quick way to find the sessions you’ve quietly stopped using.

Assigning to athletes

Assign a template to any athlete on your roster. augo tracks how many times that athlete has completed a workout descended from it, so you can see at a glance whether a key session is actually getting done.

One-off sessions

Not everything needs to become a template. You can assign a one-off workout without saving it to the library — useful for the session you built because of one specific week.

faqs.question: Can I search my workout library?
faqs.answer: Yes, with typo-tolerant free-text search across title and purpose, plus filters for discipline, RPE, estimated duration and last-used date.

faqs.question: Can I see how often an athlete has done a session?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you look at a template in the context of a specific athlete, augo reports how many times that athlete has completed a workout descended from it.

faqs.question: Do I have to save every workout as a template?
faqs.answer: No. One-off workouts can be assigned directly without adding them to your library.
